steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on with the engine off.
Press the Driver Information Center button until OIL LIFE REMAINING shows.
Press and hold the SET/RESET button for more than five seconds, until the reading shows 100%.
oil.note: Checked in the 2007 Getting to Know Your Impala guide and the 2013 owner's manual.

steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Turn the ignition on with the engine off.
Press the accelerator pedal fully to the floor and release it three times within five seconds.
Start the car. If the CHANGE ENGINE OIL SOON message does not come back, the reset worked. If it does, repeat the steps.
oil.note: Checked in the 2014 and 2017 owner's manuals. On 2017 cars you can also show REMAINING OIL LIFE with the right-hand steering wheel controls and hold the check-mark button for a few seconds.

steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label on the driver's door pillar (cold means parked at least three hours or driven under a mile).
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light stays on until the pressure is corrected, then goes off on its own.
If a CHECK TIRE PRESSURE message shows, acknowledging it only hides it for now. It comes back at the next start if a tire is still low.
Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the Tire and Loading Information label on the driver's door pillar.
There is no reset button. The low tire pressure light stays on until the pressure is corrected, then goes off on its own after a short drive.
